info.title: Walmart+
info.description: API for bulk enrollment/unenrollment of items in Walmart Plus program

post.description:
This API endpoint allows you to efficiently manage item participation in the Walmart+ program. Use it to enroll eligible items in Walmart+ or to unenroll items that are currently part of the program.
Market availability: US Download and review the Excel template sample and the JSON body sample to ensure proper formatting of the updated file before uploading it for processing.

parameters.name: feedType
parameters.description: The type of feed, which specifies the nature of the update.

parameters.name: requestType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of request for the Walmart+ SFF (Seller-Fulfilled) program.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. This is required for authenticating requests to Walmart Marketplace APIs.

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to identify the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID that identifies each API call and is used to track and debug issues. Use a randomly generated GUID for this ID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Walmart service being called.

parameters.name: WM_MARKET
parameters.description: Identifies the Walmart Marketplace region for the request. If not specified, US is used by default.

requestBody.description: The request body consists of an Excel file or a JSON containing Walmart Plus enrollment data to be uploaded.

fileName.description: Upload an Excel file or a JSON file containing the data for Walmart+ enrollment or unenrollment.

200.description: Indicates successful operation. The response provides details on both successful and failed item enrollments or unenrollments, allowing you to review which items were updated and which encountered issues.

errors.description: Contains a list of high-level errors encountered during the operation.

feedId.description: A unique ID returned from the Bulk Upload API, used for tracking the feed file.
